title: Grateful Dead Live at The Fabulous Fox Theatre on 1970-02-02
lineage: Reel (Dolby B Decoded) -> WAV (24bit/96k)Mastering Info:Wav (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a peak‑era show highlighted by a soaring Dark Star and a killer sequence through St. Stephen, Mason's, Good Lovin' and Uncle John's.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised as one of the band’s peaks – Dark Star and The Other One are described as perfected, and the long second‑set suite (Dark Star > St. Stephen > Mason’s > Good Lovin' > Uncle John’s) is called “totally wicked.”  The Miller/Gans SBD source is noted for its clarity and fidelity, with only a minor audible reel‑change that does not detract from the overall listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews give consistently high scores (5, 4, 4, 4) and focus on both superb musical moments and a clean soundboard source; the strong show quality outweighs only minor recording quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Original circular SBD (Miller/Gans) with clear, balanced mix; a brief reel‑change is audible after ~4 min but does not affect overall fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A single, late‑started long set that flows brilliantly through a high‑energy sequence; reviewers note the show feels like a milestone in the band’s development.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for stepping up and delivering peak‑era guitar work.
